<!-- pr-reviewer: e14ee4a29ef9ec952404794ecf1f580e84561cfd -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat`: at the next cut). Reviewed commit e14ee4a2 only; #603 is below it and was not re-reviewed.

**What looks good**
- The typed Apply goes through one undoable `AlignPartToSetup` (`CommandKind::AlignPart` gains `pivot`, `state.rs`). The UI only queues the command; there are no sys_* or world calls from UI.
- `setup_turn.rs` has no unwrap/expect/panic and checks the result is finite. An all-zero turn is "as modelled" for either pivot. The WCS pivot reads the same origin the post does.
- Presets still use the part centre. `PlaneLay::flip` is untouched, and only the UI draft defaults changed (Face down / Points down), so saved projects load as before (project_roundtrip passes).
- Structural test now asserts the properties-pane rect (the #330 spill).
- No snapshot PNGs changed. No Cargo, build.rs, scripts or .github changes. New module has a provenance line. `docs/decisions/606-align-pivot.md` is present. Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #606`, and the PR does not edit CHANGELOG.md.

**Local results** (merged with upstream/main: already up to date, no conflicts)
| check | result |
|---|---|
| turn_pivot | 5 pass |
| setup_align / plane_align / plane_align_edges / points_align / axis_align / winding_align | 9 / 9 / 5 / 8 / 10 / 9 pass |
| setup_relative / setup_carry / setup_wcs / setup_sheet | 9 / 9 / 7 / 7 pass |
| commands_undo / project_roundtrip | 32 / 69 pass |
| camcraft-ui --lib (from crates/ui) | 387 pass, 1 fail: `headless_run_succeeds`, "No suitable graphics adapter found" (environmental) |
| clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/app/src/commands/setup_align.rs` is 360 lines, under the limit. `state.rs` was already far over 400 and gained only a few lines.
- Not exercised: a hands-on check in a fresh build (as the PR body says). I did not open the GUI.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 87f41197fbfcc481d947fe09f08a23643823e70a -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (full re-review at the new head, 87f41197).

**What looks good**
- The typed-angle turn pivots on the setup's WCS origin through `setup::wcs_entity` (`crates/app/src/setup_turn.rs:52`), the same lookup the rest of the app uses, defaulting to zero when none is placed. No second G54-G59 derivation.
- The pivot math is p' = R(p - q) + o, with q the document point the current alignment holds on the origin. Re-applying the same angles is refused rather than drifting. Non-finite results are refused by name (`setup_turn.rs:77`).
- It is one `AlignPartToSetup` command. Stock and carried steps follow in `apply`/`invert` (`commands/setup_align.rs:228-246`), and a stock shared with another setup is refused by name.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in the new app modules. The pivot choice is a UI draft; the presets keep the part-centre pivot.
- The merge kept main's alignment code (#573/#666/#668). The one new commit only adds `pivot: Default::default()` to main's gizmo test (`wcs_gizmo_tests.rs:43`), which is the minimum the new `CommandKind::AlignPart` field needs. It is justified, and `Default` is the WCS origin, so the test's expectation is unchanged.
- No snapshot PNGs, no `build.rs`, scripts, `.github` or dependency changes. A decision file is present.

**Local results (merged with main 4827fde6; the branch already contains it)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app`: turn_pivot 5/5, plane_align 9/9, points_align 8/8, axis_align 10/10, winding_align 9/9, setup_align 9/9, mcp_setup 5/5.
- `camcraft-ui --lib` (from crates/ui), filter plane/setup/axis/gizmo/structural/points/align: 88 passed, 0 failed.
- clippy `-D warnings` on camcraft-app and camcraft-ui (lib, bins, and the touched app test binaries): clean.
- `clippy --all-targets` stops on a file this PR does not touch, and the same file is on main:
```
crates\app\tests\lathe_thread_travel.rs:83:18  error[E0063]: missing field `hand` in OpParams::Threading
```
This is a main breakage (a Threading `hand` field added without updating that test), not this PR's. Worth its own issue if not already filed.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The PR is stacked on #603 and carries its commits. It should merge after #603/#593.
- `setup_align.rs` is 386 lines, close to the 400-line cap.
- Not exercised here: a hands-on check. The contributor's hand-check comment reports a pass.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
